state: Gold futures settled near $3,668 on 27 Nov, 4.4% higher on the week, 9.0% lower on the month and 18.1% lower over three months, about 31% below the 52-week high of $5,318 (Yahoo Finance). The weekly move is inside the 7% Alert line, leaving the three-month fall of more than 8% in the Watch band.
